interface.title: ALIGNED – Reform Track (Assessing Legal and Institutional Governance Norms in European Democracies)
interface.field: Political science / European studies: EU enlargement and content analysis of European Commission Country (Progress) Reports for Serbia
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and presenting an already-coded dataset (descriptive analysis, making figures, exporting data)
interface.what_it_is_for: A dashboard that charts how European Commission reports scored Serbia's reform progress from 2015 to 2023, sentence by sentence (each sentence coded from −1 to +1). You can split the scores by dimension, by effort type, by topic or by World-Systems interest group, view them as a yearly trend or a ranked bar chart, and export the chart and the data.

data.note: The bundled aligned_data.xlsx loads by itself when the page opens: 483 coded sentences, 2015–2023, with no 2017 point on the year axis. Four summary cards (Average Score, Sentences, Years, Negative %) recalculate for every filter, including the year range, so any count or mean quoted below holds only for the year range it names. The chart download button is labelled 'Download Chart (HTML)' from the start, so the SVG export through kaleido did not work on this server and the HTML fallback was used.

features.name: Preset comparison buttons
features.general: One click loads a named comparison, sets the underlying filter controls to match, and redraws the chart. The rest of the state (time window, chart type) is kept.
features.specific: Full Picture / Pol. vs Econ. / Dom. vs Intl. / World-Systems buttons. Each ticks the matching Customise checkboxes or turns on the WSA lens, highlights the active button, and leaves the year range and the Trend/Ranking view as they were.
steps: Press a preset button
See the Customise checkboxes or the WSA badge update to match
Read the redrawn lines or bars and the KPI cards
Switch the view or change the year range; the preset carries over
serves_tasks: Compare two broad dimensions over time
Compare two kinds of effort over time and as averages
Compare theory-defined primary and secondary groups over time
See the overall yearly trend of the scores along with summary statistics
Rank every category by its average score

features.name: Facet checkboxes and searchable category list that clear each other
features.general: Build a subset in one of two ways: tick facet checkboxes, or pick items in a searchable multi-select. Using one clears the other, so the chart always shows a single clear comparison. Ticking one value from each of two facets intersects them into a single series; each picked list item becomes its own series or bar.
features.specific: Customise checkboxes (Political / Economic × Domestic / International) and Free topic selection (fuzzy search, 'Select all' / 'Select N matches'). Picking free topics unticks the checkboxes; ticking Political clears the free topics. Political + Domestic gives one 'Political (domestic efforts)' series.
steps: Tick facet checkboxes, or type in the topic search and pick matches
See each picked topic become its own series or bar, or two ticked facets combine into one intersection series
Switch to the other control and see the previous selection cleared
Read the KPI cards recalculated for the subset
serves_tasks: Pick specific categories by searching and compare their average scores
Combine two filter dimensions into one subset
Compare two broad dimensions over time

features.name: Theory lens with group selector and per-group drill-down
features.general: Apply a theoretical classification that sorts categories into two groups. Show both groups, or only one, as aggregate series, then break either group into its member categories. Picking a member turns the lens on by itself. The lens is a separate mode from the facet and search filters: ticking a facet clears the lens picks.
features.specific: World-Systems Analysis panel: Both / Primary / Secondary interests radio buttons, plus 'Disaggregate: primary interests' (Migration, Normalisation of Relations with Kosovo, External Relations, Regional Cooperation) and 'Disaggregate: secondary interests' (Civil Society, Public Administration Reform, Freedom of Expression, Fundamental Rights) multi-selects. The unused group's list hides when only one group is chosen. An ACTIVE badge shows when the lens is on. Ticking Political clears the WSA picks.
steps: Press World-Systems, or pick a topic in a disaggregate list, to turn the lens on
Choose Both, Primary or Secondary interests
Disaggregate the chosen group into individual topics (or Select all)
Compare in Trend or Ranking view
serves_tasks: Compare theory-defined primary and secondary groups over time
Restrict to one group and break it into its member categories
Mix categories from both groups in one comparison

features.name: Trend / ranking chart toggle with live KPI cards
features.general: Show the same filtered subset either as yearly mean lines, with max/min reference lines and hover values, or as horizontal bars of overall means sorted by score with value labels. Summary cards above the chart (mean, count, period, share negative) update with every filter.
features.specific: View radio ('Trend over time' / 'Overall ranking') over a Plotly line or bar chart on a −1 to +1 scale, with the Average Score / Sentences / Years / Negative cards above it.
steps: Set the filters
Choose Trend over time and hover points for year-by-year values
Switch to Overall ranking to see the categories sorted by mean
Read the KPI cards for the current subset
serves_tasks: Rank every category by its average score

Compare two kinds of effort over time and as averages

features.name: Year-range slider over the available years
features.general: A two-handle range slider that only lands on years present in the data. Dragging or pressing arrow keys narrows the time window for the chart, the KPIs and the exports, and the window survives preset changes.
features.specific: YEAR RANGE slider (2015–2023; 2017 absent, so it has 8 stops). Moving it changes the Years card (e.g. 2019–2022), the chart x-axis, the bar means and the CSV rows.
steps: Drag the start handle (or focus it and press arrow keys)

features.name: Chart and data export
features.general: Export the chart that is currently shown and the summary table behind it, matched to the active filters and view. If image export is unavailable, the chart is saved as interactive HTML instead. A PNG can also come from the chart toolbar.
features.specific: 'Download Chart (HTML)' gives aligned_chart.html, the HTML fallback because kaleido's SVG failed. 'Download Data (CSV)' gives aligned_data.csv with year × series columns in Trend view or Category,Average Score in Ranking view. The Plotly camera icon gives plot-image.png.

Press Download Data (CSV) and get a table matching the chart
